Each iteration uses 2 collectives instead of 1 all-reduce, yielding 16 total dispatches. Enables better overlap of communication with local negrelu computation on partial results, potentially hiding local-op latency.

strategies.name: Batched All-Reduce with Interleaved Computation

Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reorders computation to maximize overlap. Represents communication-computation overlap optimization without changing collective primitive choice.

Exploit the num_nodes parameter by performing intra-node reductions first (using node-local subgroups), computing intermediate scaling factors, then inter-node reductions. Each of 8 iterations uses 2-3 collectives (intra-node + inter-node), totaling 16-24 dispatches.
